mapper.sql:
r.report_id AS reportId, r.report_target_id AS reportTargetId, r.report_reason_type AS reportReasonType, r.report_status AS reportStatus, r.report_regdate AS reportRegdate, r.report_target_type AS reportTargetType,
reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, reported.nickname AS reportedUserNickname,
CASE r.report_target_type WHEN 'findboard' THEN (SELECT f.find_board_title FROM tblFindBoard f WHERE f.find_board_id = r.report_target_id) WHEN 'question' THEN (SELECT q.question_board_title FROM tblQuestionBoard q WHERE q.question_board_id = r.report_target_id) WHEN 'review' THEN (SELECT re.review_board_title FROM tblReviewBoard re WHERE re.review_post_id = r.report_target_id) WHEN 'hotdeal' THEN (SELECT h.hotdeal_title FROM tblHotDealPost h WHERE h.hotdeal_id = r.report_target_id) ELSE '삭제되거나 알 수 없는 게시글' END AS postTitle
